caseNameFull: Gary F. MANGUM, et ux., Individually and as Parents of I.M., a Minor v. RENTON SCHOOL DISTRICT 403.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioners allowed until April 27, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
